objective: Make dark-mode Wall post details readable, increase Connect Notes, show status notes adjacent to Wall author avatars and keep public profile pictures visible even on privacy-locked member pages, without widening access to private information.
productionBaselineEvidence: Production main SHA 3b488fa704b804f05c5a289a7e0775daeabb2404; latest preexisting staging story candidate SHA a9e8e74c80bbbdb4496ef8b836cde896434119ac. This PR branches only from staging candidate. No production release, migrations, Ads SDK, or runtime changes.
chosenApproach: Use selected global BuklodTheme semantic tokens inside post-detail styles; widen Note bubbles and reserve equal vertical slots; compose one read-only, deduplicated cached profile note chip beside author identities; reuse existing authenticated public-avatar lookup while locked profile details stay hidden.
selectionRationale: Directly addresses screenshot issues with isolated UI patches; avoids backend policy widening, duplicate avatar RPC implementations, media player or ad lifecycle changes and native rebuild.
alternativeApproaches: Loosening profile table RLS or disabling profile lock to show avatars: rejected for privacy and security.
Overhauling all Wall and Connect layouts or global themes: rejected for regression risk to current ads, video rendering and navigation.
preserveBehaviors: All current native AdMob first-view and prewarm behavior, actual SDK impressions and cooldowns stay untouched.
Community photo and video playback, visible scroll pause, comments/reactions/sharing and navigation behavior remain unchanged.
Lock hides private profile details and posts; only existing public avatar may display in lock view.
Current approved 144 Bible stories, Henry translation and runtime 1.3.2 stay inherited unchanged from staging source.
acceptanceChecks: Focused Node tests on exact PR head for dark-mode contrast, Connect Notes fixed alignment, Wall Notes and locked avatar privacy.
PR Engineering Accountability objective-scope gate, navigation and ad/media protective regression checks green.
Expo Android Hermes export and TypeScript validation on combined staging RC, no native or production mutation.
Owner skipped physical device verification; do not represent that as passed.
Staging OTA only after existing signed staging APK, runtime/channel and source-SHA gates; production promotion separate.
